verses.text: Ix tak'wi Jehová: --Olto wal ila' tas ol wutok winh sreyal Egipto tik. Yet' wipal ol ex yaktanel winh. Ha in ol wak' pural winh, ol ex spechanel winh t'a yol schonhab' tik, xchi.
Ix lolonxi Jehová yet' winhaj Moisés, ix yalani: --Ha inton Jehová in.
In ch'oxnak in b'a t'a winhaj Abraham, t'a winhaj Isaac yet' t'a winhaj Jacob, t'a in b'i, Dios Syal Yuj Smasanil. Palta a in b'i JEHOVÁ, maj wak'laj yojtakejel heb' winh tas syalelk'ochi.
In b'onak in trato yet' heb' winh, wak'annak in ti' wak'an lum Canaán t'a heb' winh, haton lum b'aj ek'lejnak kajan heb' winh.

Ha tiknaik, toxo ix wila'' to te ilb'ajk'ol tz'utaj heb' in chonhab' t'a Egipto tik, yelxo wal tz'ixtaj heb' t'a munlajel yuj heb' aj Egipto tik. Yuj chi', ix in nakot in trato yet' heb' he mam eyicham chi'.

Ha tiknaik, b'at al t'a heb' etisraelal chi': Ha Jehová tz'alan icha tik: Ha in Jehová in, ol ex in kolel b'aj ayex och chekab'ok tik, b'aj ilb'aj ex k'ol yuj munlajel t'a Egipto tik. Ol in ch'ox wal wipalil, ol wak'anoch niwak yaelal t'a yib'anh jun chonhab' tik. Icha wal chi' ol aj ex in kolanel t'a yol sk'ab' jun chonhab' tik.
Ol ex och in chonhab'ok, a inxo ol in och he Diosalok. Icha chi' ol aj eyojtakaneli to a in Jehová he Diosal in tzex in kolel t'a yol sk'ab' heb' aj Egipto tik b'aj ayex och t'a syaelal yuj munlajel.

Ol ex wik'anb'at t'a sat lum lum b'aj wak'nak in ti' wak'an t'a winhaj Abraham, t'a winhaj Isaac yet' t'a winhaj Jacob. Ha inxo Jehová in tik swalpax t'ayex to eyik ol aj lu'um, xchi Jehová, xa chi t'a heb'.
Masanil tas ix yal Jehová, ha' ix yal winhaj Moisés t'a heb' yetisraelal chi', palta maj schalaj yab' heb', yujto te somchajnakel sk'ol heb' yuj syail munlajel.
Ixlajwi chi, ix yalanxi Jehová t'a winhaj Moisés chi':
--Ixik al t'a winh sreyal Egipto chi' to tzex yaktejel winh t'a sat sluum tik, xchi Jehová.
Ix tak'wi winhaj Moisés chi' t'ay: --Ina max schalaj yab' heb' wetchonhab' tas swala', okxom wal winh rey, tom ol scha yab' winh, ina to max wal yal-laj in loloni, xchi winh.
Yuj chi' ix chekjib'at winh yet' winhaj Aarón yuj Jehová yik b'at lolon heb' winh t'a heb' yetisraelal yet' t'a winh rey, yujto alb'ilxo t'a heb' to ol yik'elta heb' yetchonhab' heb' t'a Egipto chi'.

Haton sb'i heb' yajal t'a junjun makanhil heb' yinhtilal Israel t'a stzolal: Ha winhaj Rubén sb'ab'el yuninal winhaj Israel. Haxo heb' yuninal winh, haton heb' tik: Winhaj Hanoc, winhaj Falú, winhaj Ezrón yet' winhaj Carmi. Haton heb' tik yajal yaj t'a skal junjun makan yinhtilal winhaj Rubén chi'.

Ha heb' yuninal winhaj Simeón, haton heb' tik: Winhaj Jemuel, winhaj Jamín, winhaj Ohad, winhaj Jaquín, winhaj Zohar yet' winhaj Saúl yune' jun ix aj Canaán. Haton heb' tik yajal yaj t'a skal junjun makan yinhtilal winhaj Simeón chi'.
Ha winhaj Leví, 137 ab'il ix ek' winh. Ha sb'i heb' yuninal winh t'a stzolal haton heb' tik: Winhaj Gersón, winhaj Koat yet' winhaj Merari.
Ha heb' yuninal winhaj Gersón, haton heb' tik: Winhaj Libni yet' winhaj Simei. Haton heb' tik yajal yaj t'a junjun makan.
Ha winhaj Koat chi', 133 ab'il ix ek' winh. Ha sb'i heb' yuninal winh, haton tik: Winhaj Amram, winhaj Izhar, winhaj Hebrón yet' winhaj Uziel.
Eb' yuninal winhaj Merari, haton heb' tik: Winhaj Mahli yet' winhaj Musi. Haton heb' tik yajal yaj t'a junjun makan yinhtilal winhaj Leví yet' yuninal heb'.
Ha winhaj Amram ix yik'laj sb'a winh yet' ix Jokabed yanab' winh smam winh, haton heb' ay yik winhaj Aarón yet' winhaj Moisés. Ha winhaj Amram chi' 137 ab'il ix yil winh, ix cham winh.
Ha heb' yuninal winhaj Izhar, haton heb' tik: Winhaj Coré, winhaj Nefeg yet' winhaj Zicri.
Ha heb' yuninal winhaj Uziel, haton heb' tik: Winhaj Misael, winhaj Elzafán yet' winhaj Sitri.
Ha winhaj Aarón ix yik' sb'a winh yet' ix Elisabet, yisil winhaj Aminadab, yanab' winhaj Naasón. Haxo yuninal heb', haton heb' tik: Winhaj Nadab, winhaj Abiú, winhaj Eleazar yet' winhaj Itamar.
Eb' yuninal winhaj Coré, haton heb' tik: Winhaj Asir, winhaj Elcana yet' winhaj Abiasaf. Haton heb' tik yajal yaj t'a junjun makan heb' yinhtilal winhaj Coré.

Haxo winhaj Eleazar yuninal winhaj Aarón, ix yik' sb'a winh yet' ix yisil winhaj Futiel. Ix alji jun yune' ix, haton winhaj Finees. Haton heb' tik yajal yaj t'a junjun makan heb' yinhtilal winhaj Leví.
Haxo winhaj Aarón yet' winhaj Moisés sb'inaj t'a jun lista tik, haton t'a heb' winh tik ix yal Jehová to a heb' winh ol ik'anelta heb' israel t'a Egipto t'a stzolal.
Haton heb' winh ix xit'ek' lolonel yet' winh sreyal Egipto yik wach' syaktejelta heb' chonhab' israel chi' winh.
Ix lolon Jehová t'a winhaj Moisés t'a Egipto, ix yalani:
--Ha in ton Jehová in. Al t'a winh sreyal Egipto masanil tastak swal tik t'ayach, xchi t'a winh.
Ix tak'wi winhaj Moisés chi' icha tik: --Mamin, yelxo wal max yal-laj in loloni, ¿tas wal ol aj yab'an winh rey tas ol wala'? xchi winh.
